items.title: IRGC Navy claims 35 vessels transited Strait of Hormuz with its 'permission' on May 22
items.summary: Iran's IRGC Navy announced 35 vessels transited the Strait of Hormuz on May 22 with its authorization, continuing Tehran's 'permission-based' transit regime.

items.title: Iran's new Persian Gulf Strait Authority publishes controlled maritime zone map
items.summary: Iran's newly created Persian Gulf Strait Authority released a map delineating a controlled maritime zone that vessels cannot transit without Tehran's authorization.
items.source: web-search:Iran Hormuz shipping last 24 hours May 2026

items.title: Iran rial remittance rate reaches 1,762,000 IRR/USD on May 23, up 10,000 from prior day
items.summary: The USD remittance rate in Iran's open market stands at 1,762,000 IRR on Saturday May 23, a 0.57% daily increase, remaining below the F8 and D1 trigger thresholds of 2,000,000.
items.source: web-search:Iran rial exchange rate today May 23 2026

items.title: Trump rejects Iran-Oman Hormuz toll discussions, demands free international passage
items.summary: Trump told reporters the U.S. has 'total control' of Hormuz and opposed any toll system, saying 'It's an international waterway — we want it open and free.'

items.title: Trump cancels weekend plans, meets NSC, gives Iran early-next-week deadline for peace offer
items.summary: Trump stayed in Washington Friday to meet top national security officials on Iran, giving Tehran a loose deadline of early next week to return an acceptable peace proposal.

items.title: Trump signals flexibility on nuclear program, would accept 20-year enrichment suspension
items.summary: Trump said he would accept a 20-year uranium enrichment suspension instead of a permanent halt if Iran provides a 'real' guarantee, marking an apparent softening of the U.S. nuclear demand.

items.title: Fifth round of US-Iran Rome talks ends without deal; both sides agree to continue
items.summary: Oman-mediated Rome talks concluded without a breakthrough but with 'preliminary understandings' on sanctions and uranium; Hormuz status and security guarantees remain unresolved; a 30-day detailed talks window may open after a Declaration of Principles is approved.

items.title: Al Jazeera live: Tehran says diplomacy continues but no deal yet with US as of May 23
items.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry confirmed diplomatic channels remain active while denying any deal has been reached; Witkoff and Araghchi reportedly held a brief in-person exchange after Rome's fifth round.
